notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS: PATCH 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Greetings, Peregrine Falcons!

We’ve just deployed a new patch to smoother your future missions! 
Check out the list of all the changes and bug fixes:

UX:

 Preview of Special Actions superior levels on Level Up and in Barracks

Features:

 Refusing a Strategic Asset grants 5 coins
 New weapon mods that change the user’s Max HP
 Improved the algorithm that randomly draws missions in a biome

Balancing:

 Trevor’s Flying Blade II & III now cost 3 ADR
 Trevor can now target himself with Nanoshroud

Bug Fixes:

 There cannot be several weapon mods of the same upgrade chain when choosing a reward
 Eri’s Secret Service achievement could not be triggered with Clark’s Jump into Action, Tarma’s Final Crash and Ralf’s Overhead
 Trevor’s Flying Blade sometimes did not inflict damage when the target was too far
 Trevor’s Jet Lag reduced Special Actions costs by 2 instead of 1
 Trevor’s Nanoshroud applies the correct bonus movement effects
 Characters who died while in Mummy status played their idle animation on the next turn and appeared alive
 Some effects were not properly applied or removed after Aeshi Nero’s Laser and Bite attacks (e.g. Protection status was not removed)
 Path preview was not properly rendered on top of the map, mainly where there was a Jump
 Path preview Jump was sometimes vertically misplaced
 Path preview was improved for big jumps (eg. when landing on a Leaf Pile)
 Fixed path preview for the Slugnoid
 Fio’s Helping Hand passive did not work for some of her Special Actions
 Fio’s Extra Motivation passive did not work for some of her Special Actions
 Fio’s Field Dressing did not always correctly preview the healing bonus
 Fio’s Germi Style could trigger Fio’s weapon’s effects even if no sync was triggered
 Hid the Rewards panel on JupiterKing’s mission
 Miners are not affected by Nadia’s electric mines
 Slugs are not affected by Nadia’s electric mines
 Brawn’s bonus can only be activated once per turn per unit
 Brawn’s bonus was not activated if the attack triggered a revenge hit
 After gaining a bonus action, the unit’s UI was in some cases not properly updated
 Improved Paqar SFX integration when swapping idols
 Fixed Paqar’s idols hit and destroy animations
 Paqar’s destroyed idols were not correctly respawned on Reset Turn
 Paqar’s introduction can be fast-forwarded
 Fixed Slugs Popup (Armor and Fuel label)
 Fixed the Tutorial reset button
 Fixed Trevor’s animations in the HQ

If you encounter any other issues during your gameplay and require support, don't hesitate to contact us through the dedicated Steam Forum or on our Official Discord!

Leave us a review on Steam!

If you’ve been enjoying your time on Metal Slug Tactics, don’t hesitate to leave us a review on Steam! It means the world to us, and we love reading your feedback!

Your support has been really heartwarming and we cannot thank you enough for your trust, patience, and understanding.❤️

-The Metal Slug Tactics Team

notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS: PATCH 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, Peregrine Falcons!
We’ve just deployed a fresh patch for Metal Slug Tactics on Steam! This update is all about bug fixes, balancing tweaks, performance boosts, and quality-of-life enhancements to make your tactical battles smoother and more exciting than ever.
Here’s what’s included in this update:


Balancing & Feature
 Reworked Clark’s Argentine Backbreaker to differentiate it from Stargazer. Now Clark
rushes towards the enemy before hurling them.
 Clark’s Argentine Backbreaker costs -1 ADR (all 3 levels)
 You can now give up your current run at any time. This triggers the Defeat screen,
grants currency rewards, and then takes you back to the Character Selection screen.
 Rebind for Camera Move (WASD) added
 Rebind for cursor superposition cycling added. Default keys: page up/page down
 Protect Miners is now easier for the first 3 difficulties, lowered the count of required miners to be kept alive to complete the mission
 Trevor’s Shinobi I & II now cost +1 ADR
 Trevor’s Shinobi III now doesn’t grant a bonus action if the target dies
 Trevor’s Flying Blade now doesn’t grant a bonus action if the target dies (all 3 levels)
 Trevor’s Flying Blade now has a reduced launch range, reduced damage for level 3, and increased ADR cost for level 1


Feedback & Interface
 The Desynchronized feedback on bosses is now triggered after all sync attacks have
been performed
 Increased screen size for Special Action upgrade popups
 Improved AOE now display in popups
 Enemies’ level is now displayed in their popup
 Profiles do not use display names anymore, nor they require a keyboard for
creation
 The 3 available profile slots are displayed explicitly


Bug Fixes & Performance Optimizations
 Lightning Idol now deals damage on high ground
 Explosive props destroyed in a Sync attack now correctly apply their damage
 Players can now sync on targets hit by an explosive prop
 Syncs, including destructible crates, are now properly previewed
 The Convoy is not hurt by Geyers
 The Convoy does no longer open Sarcophagi
 Fixed the “Spy” achievement
 When moving an enemy with a Special Action in a mine’s AOE, the mine is now only
triggered if the enemy is not killed by the action, or if another enemy is in the AOE
 Enemy Chaser now correctly predicts sync attacks
 Fixed Special Actions that could not hit Dragon Nosuke : Dynamite Punch, Enemy
Chaser, Galactica Phantom
 Fixed pathfinding bug after room transitions in Dragon Nosuke’s mission
 The game now keeps backups for save files if the game/computer crashes during the
save process
 Sync attacks are no longer previewed for units killed by the original attack
 Spotlight II & III AOEs should now correctly display in popups
 Fixed an issue for which delayed Hits for the Rebel Tower were sometimes not correctly restored on reload or reset turn
 Rewards drawn in the Outpost are now saved and won’t change on reload
 Incubator animations now play correctly
 Special Actions cannot break anymore when opening the Pause Menu during
preview
 The destroyed Rebel Tower now stays on screen
 The camera now starts at the correct position when reloading the Dragon Nosuke mission
 The “War Machines” achievement now correctly triggers when defeating Dragon Nosuke
 Target statuses don’t count for the “A Sister” achievement
 Combustion triggers if a sync kills an enemy
 Units in Slugs are not killed during room transitions
 Correctly initialize reinforcements when selecting another difficulty
 Destroy idols objective counter
 Hide the enter slug UI “IN” feedback after destruction
 Cannot one-shot Abul Abbas and Allen O’Neil by invoking slugs on their position
 Don't play idle for empty slugs on continue
 Lingering character visual when resetting a turn with a character inside a slug
 Alice is now correctly restored on continue
 Added bleeding effect description
 Fixed all occurrences of several music tracks playing at the same time
 Improved performance when there are Delayed Hits
 Improved performance for Jupiter King
 Improved performance when playing with a controller
 Improved performance when displaying units range
 Improved general performances in mission
Sounds
 Polish, resync, and added missing SFX for
○ Leona's Skills and her afterimages (attack type/hits)
○ Nadia's Skills
○ Trevor's Skills
○ Clark's Skills
○ Ralf’s Skills
 Enhanced "no damage" feedback
 Mummy players now no longer trigger Flamethrower or grenade sound upon weapon
selection
 Fixed announcer randomly not saying "you're great" on level up


If you encounter any other issues during your gameplay and require support, please contact us through the dedicated Steam Forum or our Official Discord. Your feedback and suggestions are also welcome.

Thank you for your trust, patience, and understanding. Your support means the world to us!

-The Metal Slug Tactics Team

notes.title: METAL SLUG TACTICS: PATCH 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Greetings, Peregrine Falcons!

We've just rolled out a small patch for Metal Slug Tactics on Steam to fix a few issues and bugs. This isn’t a major update, but these tweaks should make your current experience way smoother!


UI:
 Increased font size for: 
 All popups
 Tooltips
 Character reactions
 Mission UI: cancel move button, objectives, deploy units…
 Rewards Legend
 Level Up 
 Turn order popup shows Rumi's order
 Nadia’s Mine tooltip 

Optimizations:
 First Blood damage modifier optimized
 Controller memory leaks optimized

Audio:
 Missing SFX for Paqar’s Totem swap now should appear correctly

Debug:
 Fixed equipped weapon glitch that could happen after exiting a vehicle
 Fixed the Metal Slug main cannon attack animation
 Node Superposition tooltip: the mouse icon should now appear correctly
 Optimized Save Profiles management
 Frags made by invocations (Alice, Gunbot, Iron Lizard, After Image) now count as frags for their invoker
 Frags made from a vehicle now count for objectives
 Frags made with a Crane now count for objectives
 Credits: "Compositor" role corrected to "Composer"
 End Turn now doesn't require holding on the keyboard
 The game now ensures that all achievements validated ingame are validated on the platform as well 
 Rumi’s name is now displayed
 Alice's status now has a description
 Alice’s SFX now does not play indefinitely after going back to the menu
 Outpost: fixed Rumi's name that could be hidden behind the reroll button
 The green color should no longer stick to the tile after reviving a character.
 Characters should no longer keep the mummy attacks after being killed as a mummy and revived.
 Leona's afterimages can now be walked through by other units
 Nadia can no longer sync with her handgun while gunbot is spawned
 Fio's Field Dressing passive skill now triggers correctly on Acupuncture Boost
 Gunbot can no longer gain infinite XP and coins for saving prisoners
 Tesla Ammo should now activate after undoing a move
 Quitting to the Main Menu then Continue'ing decremented the number of turns left before a destination room reveals by 1
 Corrected a crash that happened when a berserker retribution hit killed Leona 
 Dragon Nosuke can now be correctly targeted
 The menu font should now correctly adapt to Turkish language
 Instigator II & III weapon mods now correctly add sync damage
 The description for Gunbot Self Destruct should now be correctly displayed
 The description for Rage ability and status (Natives) should now be correctly displayed


If you encounter any other issues during your gameplay and require support, please contact us through the dedicated Steam Forum or our Official Discord. Your feedback and suggestions are also welcome.

Thank you for your patience and understanding,

-The Metal Slug Tactics Team

notes.title: RELEASE DATE REVEALED
notes.notes:
Greetings Squad,

It is with great pleasure that we can finally say: MISSION START on November 5th! 
And that’s not all! METAL SLUG TACTICS will launch with long-awaited reinforcements, the legendary Ikari Warriors: Clark, Ralf, and Leona!

Watch our brand-new trailer to see them in action:

[previewyoutube=DYLtBnTjdvk;full][TRAILER][/previewyoutube]

ABOUT THE IKARI WARRIORS:

Clark Still: The tough and cool grappler is back! Using his immense strength, Clark hurls enemies across the map while dishing out some serious status-inflicting damage.
Ralf Jones: The hot-headed one-man army returns! Ralf gets up close and personal with fiery punches and charges at enemies like a raging bull.
Leona Heidern: The silent soldier answers the call! Leona can replace fallen enemies with decoy afterimages to distract and overwhelm enemy forces.

See you on November 5th!
